label: spriteEveryDrag: each drag makes the live layer's pixels again, a full-layer copy and surface per drag
spriteNeverPrepared: the draft's first show makes no sprite, so the first drag waits for one
emptyBaseDrawn: on the tile path a layer with nothing under it still draws an empty picture each drag, a picture's tile surfaces more per drag
gpuTilesDrawEmptyBase: the GPU route with no presenter texture still draws an empty picture under a lone layer each drag
closeKeepsRendering: a closed window's render runs on, its tiles taking the CPU from the next window
